part.text:
Fixed. In `BufLimit::poll_read` (tokio/src/fs/file.rs:621), when the destination `ReadBuf` has no space, the code now returns `Poll::Ready(Ok(()))` immediately and keeps the buffer in the `Idle` slot, instead of spawning a 0-byte background read that would be misreported as EOF on the next poll.

Verified:
- `empty_read` (the FAIL_TO_PASS case) and all 16 other tests in `tokio --test fs_file` pass
- All `fs_*` and related `io_*` integration tests plus the 135 lib tests pass
- The only failure, `fs_try_exists`, is pre-existing on the clean tree (environment-dependent, unrelated)
